summary: This Form 6-K filed by Alpha Tau Medical Ltd. is a routine press release announcing clinical trial results from pancreatic cancer studies presented at DDW 2026. It reports a 100% local disease control rate and favorable safety profile for its Alpha DaRT therapy. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction is described. The filing is a standard current report of material non-financial information by a foreign private issuer, analogous to a Form 8-K under US rules, with no deal terms or corporate event that qualifies as a special situation.
